summary: Section 319 CrPC application to summon additional accused; High Court set aside trial court order; medical evidence lacked corroboration of injuries by alleged co-accused; police investigations found no involvement; presence at scene unestablished; momentary quarrel over volleyball; no enmity; insufficient material to warrant trial; Hardeep Singh precedent cited; standard of evidence under Section 319 CrPC considered; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.323, s.324, s.307, s.506, s.34
Hardeep Singh v. State of Punjab
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order setting aside summoning order quashed; matter remitted to High Court to reconsider in light of Hardeep Singh guidelines.
